action_items.description: 3 pre-existing browser checks unrelated to this retest's criterion (navigation/overflow) are stale against the current app and fail on selector/content mismatches, not against anything in this briefing's acceptance_matrix: (1) contact-prefilled-enquiry expects a 'contact-email-button' testid and a mailto href with ?subject=...&body=... query string - neither exists on /contact today (only 'contact-email-link' with a plain mailto href). (2) seo-foundation-correct's single script[type=application/ld+json] locator now matches 2 identical JSON-LD <script> tags per service page (duplicate structured data - functionally harmless but duplicated), causing a Playwright strict-mode violation. (3) service-detail-pages-scannable expects a 'service-overview-copy' testid that does not exist (current testid is 'service-summary'). These were not part of iteration_2's tracked checks, predate this fix, and are out of scope for the overflow criterion being retested; recommend the test suite owner either update these 3 check scripts to match current testids or have engineering dedupe the JSON-LD script tag, then re-run.
